allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5288, 5173, 5432 } | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess, @{n='Process';e={\(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-Process -Name dotnet, Pos.Api -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime, @{n='Path';e={$_.Path}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; if \(-not \(Get-Process -Name dotnet, Pos.Api -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\)\) { 'No dotnet / Pos.Api process is running.' })
